name: job-hunter
description: End-to-end job-hunt cold outreach: target the people who matter, enrich contacts, research them, draft voice-matched emails + LinkedIn DMs, review, and send — company after company, on the least tokens possible.

hunter_api_key.title: Hunter.io API key
hunter_api_key.description: From hunter.io/api-keys. Free tier = 50 credits/month with real API access. The default enrichment provider.

apollo_api_key.title: Apollo.io API key (optional)
apollo_api_key.description: From Apollo Settings → API. NOTE: programmatic enrichment requires a PAID Apollo plan. Leave blank to skip.

contactout_api_key.title: ContactOut API token (optional)
contactout_api_key.description: Paid, no self-serve key (request via sales). Last-resort enrichment fallback. Leave blank to skip.

lemlist_api_key.title: Lemlist API key (optional)
lemlist_api_key.description: From Lemlist Settings → Integrations. No free tier. Enables sequenced sending. Leave blank to use Gmail only.

gmail_token_path.title: Gmail OAuth token path
gmail_token_path.description: Where the Gmail OAuth token is stored. Default: ~/.config/job-hunter/gmail_token.json (0600). Created by /job-hunter:setup.

gmail_credentials_path.title: Gmail OAuth client secret path
gmail_credentials_path.description: Path to the Desktop-app credentials.json downloaded from Google Cloud Console. Default: ~/.config/job-hunter/credentials.json.
